decisions.reason: Its proven government deployment and wide APIS connectivity make it a core, credible fit with our aviation and border-security portfolio, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
It remains strategically aligned with integrated protection at high-risk sites, but its less-developed market evidence and likely longer enterprise sales cycles keep discontinuation risk moderate.

The document verification platform is close to our core transport and border-related offer and appears sufficiently established as a standalone product, so we would continue it with only limited withdrawal risk.
